examples.scope: Verus checks annotated callers; ordinary main and runtime assertions are executable tests

limbs.scope: Radix representation and equal-length in-place addition

benchmark.includes: In-process calls, carry checksum and black_box; allocation and I/O outside timing
benchmark.comparison: Same-algorithm ordinary Rust, not a best-available arithmetic library

cost_scope.proved_loop_visits: Exactly n for n limbs, tracked only in erased ghost state
cost_scope.source_structure: One limb addition and store per visit, no allocation or recursive execution
cost_scope.derived_word_cost: O(n) time, O(1) auxiliary words excluding caller-owned input/output

pow2.scope: Precision layout, word mask, normalization and in-place modular addition/subtraction

codegen.normalization: Block labels, panic location metadata and non-instruction directives only

benchmark.includes: In-process calls and black_box; allocation/initialization/I/O excluded
benchmark.comparison: Same-algorithm ordinary Rust, not best-available arithmetic

cost_scope.layout_mask_normalize: Constant word operations; normalize writes only the top word
cost_scope.modular_addition: One existing n-visit addition loop plus constant-time normalization
cost_scope.modular_subtraction: One n-visit borrow loop plus constant-time normalization; Euclidean residue for negative differences

codegen.verified_exports_out_of_line_calls: Only memset and entry-assertion panic; no hidden arithmetic helper
codegen.memset_allowed: Necessary output initialization; included in timing
codegen.comparison_scope: Per-export instruction inspection; ordinary iterator/control-flow differences retained, not normalized away

gmp.scope: Unverified comparator only; full 2n-limb product plus low-n copy and mask, with preallocated output/scratch

benchmark.includes: Required output zeroing, product, mask, calls and black_box; caller allocation/input setup/I/O excluded
benchmark.order: Rust pairs alternate; GMP is a separate later process, not interleaved
benchmark.gmp_allocation_scope: Caller output and 2n scratch preallocated; internal GMP allocation not instrumented

cost_scope.mac_count: n*(n+1)/2; inner and outer ghost visit invariants checked
cost_scope.fast_dispatch_threshold: Not established; no automatic full-scale backend selection

oracle.coverage: Full, both low splits, default dispatch, same-input squaring, all sign combinations, zero differences, nonzero initial storage, exact scratch capacities and canaries

codegen.copy_scope: One required low-product copy per non-leaf low call; no operand padding or recursive heap allocation
codegen.retained_checks: Entry assertions and slice-region checks; not a claim that all checks disappear

fast_multiply.gmp_abi: Header-checked 64-bit unsigned limb, zero nails, signed pointer-sized mp_size_t; FFI only in unverified benchmark

tuning.selection: Fixed default K=24, low=64, unbalanced=11/36; measured compromise, not asserted universal optimum

benchmark.order: Same process, modes rotate across seven repetitions; all results checked against GMP outside timing
benchmark.included: All arithmetic, required copying, normalization and dispatch; caller allocations/input setup/I/O excluded
benchmark.ordinary_comparison: Modes 2/5 share dynamic thresholds and algorithm; default mode 6 has constants visible to the compiler, so 6/5 is an entry-point comparison rather than isolated proof overhead
benchmark.gmp_scope: Public mpn_mul_n full 2n product followed by copy/mask; internal GMP allocation not instrumented

cost.scratch_words: Full needs 3n, low needs 4n, checked for every actual recursive call; O(log n) recursion depth
cost.derived_word_bound: O(n^log2(3)) for fixed thresholds and either supported split; analytic consequence of source recurrence, not a machine-checked closed-form cost theorem
cost.parameterized_limit: Arbitrary caller thresholds are functionally verified but may deliberately choose a quadratic path

toom.scope: Toom-3, dedicated recursive squaring, fixed production dispatch, MAC4 candidate

oracle.coverage: Default and forced recursion, three low splits, n mod 3, signed/zero evaluations, full MAX carry chains, all top bits, immutable input alias, nonzero storage, exact scratch and surrounding canaries, row tails including empty, quotient/remainder

codegen.scope: Actual fixed product/square dispatch; arbitrary-divisor API excluded from division-free claim
codegen.retained_checks: Entry assertions and slice-region checks; required copying and zero fill retained

mac4_candidate.limitation: Experimental unrolling retains per-element checks on this compiler; measured separately

benchmark.semantics: Multiplication or square modulo 2^p, including required copying/masking. Public GMP mul_n/sqr computes full product first. Allocation setup excluded, GMP internal allocation not instrumented.
benchmark.controls: Previous verified Karatsuba, forced Toom splits, full Toom, GMP, actual default; no isolated proof-overhead inference. Row control uses original loop and public GMP addmul_1.
benchmark.parameter_columns: threshold/low_limit describe forced modes 1-3; modes 0,4,5 ignore scan context. Default product: K below 512, else 192/128/9:40. Default square: 192/64/11:36.
benchmark.mac4_workload: Same initial destination and common iteration count across modes; destination reset outside timing and final states compared.
benchmark.mac4_policy: Kept as verified candidate; no consistent win over original carry loop in local measurements.
benchmark.square_base_policy: Full-square leaves use the symmetric kernel from 8 limbs; below 8 retain generic multiplication. Direct specialized low-square leaf selected only for top-level square sizes 25 through 64; original generic low path otherwise.

cost.low: L(n)=T(n-h)+2L(h)+O(n), h=floor(9n/40) or floor(11n/36) or floor(n/2)
cost.square: Dedicated five-point squares; low square computes one cross multiplication and adds it twice
cost.square_base: Triangular n(n-1)/2 cross products plus n diagonal products, one zero fill and one fused doubling/diagonal pass; O(n^2) operations and O(1) extra words, no extra scratch. Operation formula is analytic.
cost.bound: O(n^log3(5)) word operations for fixed Toom/base thresholds and all three low splits; analytic derivation, not checked cost theorem
cost.scratch_words: Full/low product 12n, full/low square 10n; checked recursive capacity; O(log n) call depth
